maps.description: ## **Dynamics of Concussion** Welcome! This model is an interactive reproduction of a causal-loop diagram (CLD) originally published by Kenzie et al. in [*Frontiers in Neurology*](https://www.frontiersin.org/articles/10.3389/fneur.2018.00203/abstract). It illustrates the complex dynamics between factors that influence recovery from concussion, or mild traumatic brain injury. The primary motivation behind the model was to better understand variability in recovery trajectories. As a preliminary model, it provides an initial snapshot of the system and demonstrates how CLDs can be used to generate insight into complex biomedical phenomena. To view a presentation walk-through of the model, click here. For a cheat sheet on how to navigate the model, see the [Navigation Guide](=#navigation-guide).
